verdict.rationale: Resend ships an official MCP server (resend-mcp) that lets AI clients like Claude and Cursor perform actions such as domain verification, webhook setup, and headless workflows via natural-language prompts, and this MCP integration is referenced across multiple docs and changelog entries. However, the natural-language interface is provided entirely through third-party MCP clients rather than a native NL command surface in Resend itself, and there's no hands-on/community evidence validating how well NL commands work in practice. Missing for 10: first-party natural-language chat/command interface not dependent on external MCP clients, and independent hands-on validation of the MCP server's NL command coverage.
